process_note: The sfnl-prompt-master skill is not available to this subagent, so this hunt ran without it under its own definition.
conviction_note: The evidence nets to about zero. Q3 is pre-determined at the top of the guide (99,964 deliveries) with a likely margin step-up, the stock has run down 15% since Nov 11 to near its 52-week low, and the i6 ramp supports Q4. Against that, October was the weakest month since February, November industry NEV retail is -13% y/y, management has guided below the street on at least the last three prints and the stock fell each time, and the 25d skew pays for downside. So p_up is 50 and abs_move is 6.5, slightly above the 5.95 implied move because a new Q4 guide is the swing and the ATM spread makes the option number indicative only. print_vs_bar (+1.5% on revenue) and expected_move (0) disagree on purpose: the quarter is not what this stock trades on, the Q4 guide is.
bar: Q3 revenue: company guide RMB26.6-28.0bn on 95-100k deliveries (https://cnevpost.com/2026/08/26/li-auto-earnings-q2-2026/); consensus about $4.09B (about RMB27.5bn at 6.72), loss of $0.08/ADS, top of the guide range after cuts from about $4.80B (Earnings Whispers, 2026-11-18, https://finviz.com/news/424957/li-auto-needs-margin-proof-as-street-bets-on-the-top-of-its-revenue-guide). Net loss consensus RMB942m against Deutsche Bank's RMB300m and 16.7% gross margin (https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/10/li-auto-updated-i6-orders-estimated-above-50000/). The revenue bar rests on a company guide plus one estimate source. The margin and EPS bar rests on one source, so the margin finding is capped small. No street Q4 2026 delivery or revenue figure could be sourced, so the guidance findings are capped too.
positioning_check: Short interest 29.93m ADS, days to cover 10.2 (shortsqueeze.com page read 2026-11-24, record date not shown, https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=LI). That is against 29.11m / 9.3 DTC on the 2026-10-23 snapshot (search snippet) and about 29.26m / 9.45 at the 2026-09-15 settlement (search snippet): flat to slightly rising, elevated in days but not a crowded share of float. Baseline 25d skew +7.26 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.97, total OI only 3,166, ATM spread 67% of mid, so the 5.95% event-implied move is indicative.

expectations.price_path: Spot $10.64 at the 2026-11-24 seal. 5-day -8.04%, 20-day -5.51%, 46.85% below the 52-week high, 2.41% above the 52-week low (baseline). The close was $12.49 on 2026-11-11 (https://www.foxbusiness.com/quote?stockTicker=LI) and $11.57 on the 2026-11-18 preview (finviz/Earnings Whispers), so the stock is down about 15% since Nov 11. No sector ETF return over the same days was found. Peer XPEV was near its own 52-week low before its 2026-11-16 print.
expectations.vs_targets: Mean and high targets not found. Deutsche Bank kept HK$76 on 2026-11-10 (https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/10/li-auto-updated-i6-orders-estimated-above-50000/) against an HK line of about HK$45 on 2026-11-13 (https://wap.stockstar.com/detail/IG2026111300022010), so spot sits about 40% below that one target.
expectations.whisper_or_buyside_bar: No whisper number found. Earnings Whispers (2026-11-18): consensus sits at the top of the revenue guide, so 'an in-line result could still disappoint'. The street needs gross margin meaningfully above 11%, near-breakeven operating cash flow, and a Q4 guide showing acceleration with stable or rising margins (https://finviz.com/news/424957/li-auto-needs-margin-proof-as-street-bets-on-the-top-of-its-revenue-guide). Sentiment is described as moving from deeply to modestly bearish.
expectations.last_print: Q2 2026 (2026-08-26): revenue RMB25.67bn beat the RMB25.07bn consensus by 2.4%, EPS loss of RMB1.49 vs RMB1.47 expected, and the Q3 revenue guide of RMB26.6-28.0bn was about 15% below the RMB32.28bn expected. Shares were -1.3% premarket, close not found (https://finviz.com/news/385565/li-auto-beats-second-quarter-revenue-forecasts-but-weak-q3-outlook-weighs-on-shares). Q1 2026 (2026-05-28): Q2 revenue guide RMB24.1-25.4bn below the 26.3bn expected, US premarket nearly -5%, HK -3.8% (https://www.itiger.com/news/1138136218).
expectations.short_interest_trend: About 29.26m (2026-09-15, DTC 9.45), then 29.11m (2026-10-23 snapshot, DTC 9.3), then 29.93m (page of 2026-11-24, DTC 10.2, https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=LI). The first two are snippet_only.
expectations.real_bar: Q3 at the top of the revenue guide is the base case. The stock needs a Q4 delivery guide that grows year on year against 109,194 (Q4 2025), meaning about 110k+ given October's 29,025, plus Q3 gross margin in the mid-teens without a cut to the 15-20% 'healthy' range on memory and battery costs.

next_guide.street_next_quarter: not found (no sourced Q4 2026 delivery or revenue consensus; Deutsche Bank's only published figure is November deliveries above 40,000, https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/10/li-auto-updated-i6-orders-estimated-above-50000/)
next_guide.company_current_guide: none for Q4 2026. The Q2 call said positive operating and free cash flow depends on Q4 deliveries (https://quartr.com/events/li-auto-inc-li-q2-2026_3P7E5Z54). A full-year ~490k target was referred to by CnEVPost (https://cnevpost.com/2026/08/26/li-auto-earnings-q2-2026/) but is not in the company summary and is unreachable (Jan-Oct 322,461).
next_guide.basis: The new Q4 guide is likely roughly 110-125k deliveries: October 29,025 plus the i6 ramp to 20k/month capacity in November and higher in December (company, 2026-10-30), the i9 at 5,460 in October and the Mega at 3,000+. Industry November retail is -13% y/y and the company has guided below the street on the Q2 and Q3 prints (and the Q1 guide was called brutal), so the direction against an unsourced street number is a coin flip leaning below.

findings.finding: Q3 deliveries were 99,964 (Jul 30,468, Aug 37,679, Sep 31,817), the top of the 95-100k guide. Revenue should therefore land near the top of the RMB26.6-28.0bn guide, about RMB27.8-28.0bn, against a consensus of about $4.09B (about RMB27.5bn), a beat of roughly 1-2% that sits inside the guided range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue beat consensus by 2.4% and the stock was still -1.3% premarket on a weak guide. This stock does not trade on the quarter's revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the deliveries were published Oct 1 and consensus already sits at the top of the guide. Only the last 1-2% of revenue from mix (i9 at 369.8k yuan, Mega Home at 509.8k) is unpriced, and that is what a revenue beat would add.
findings.independence: The consensus figure is from Earnings Whispers (https://finviz.com/news/424957/li-auto-needs-margin-proof-as-street-bets-on-the-top-of-its-revenue-guide). Monthly i9 and Mega counts are from https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/13/li-auto-i9-tops-10000-deliveries/.

findings.finding: Q3 gross margin is set up to step up from Q2's 11.0%. At the Q2 call the CFO said margins would expand further in H2 on higher-priced Livis variants, refreshed BEVs and the i9. Deutsche Bank (2026-11-10) models 16.7% gross margin and a RMB300m net loss against a RMB942m consensus loss, citing better mix and the end of cash subsidies on the old L6.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 margin rose from 7.9% to 11.0% and the stock still fell premarket on the guide. The margin line has not paid on its own in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus still carries a RMB942m loss, which implies a margin well below DB's 16.7%. If the market had priced DB's view, the loss consensus would have narrowed toward RMB300m and the stock would not have fallen 15% since Nov 11. The margin bar is single-sourced, so this is capped small.
findings.independence: CFO H2 margin-expansion comment: https://cnevpost.com/2026/08/26/li-auto-earnings-q2-2026/ (a different document from DB's note). The Earnings Whispers preview names memory, battery and PCB cost inflation as the offset.

findings.finding: Q4 volume risk: the company's own October deliveries were 29,025, -8.63% y/y and the lowest since February. CPCA has November 1-15 NEV retail at 447k, -13% y/y, and projects Nov 16-22 passenger retail at -35% y/y. Any full-year ~490k ambition is unreachable (Jan-Oct 322,461), so the Q4 delivery guide may not show growth against 109,194.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 guide below street: premarket nearly -5%, HK -3.8%. Q2 2026 guide 15% below street: -1.3% premarket. The Q4 2025 print with a weak Q1 guide also fell (Bernstein: 'brutal').
findings.why_not_priced: October and CPCA data are public and part of the 15% run-down is this. What is not priced is the guide's number itself: no street Q4 figure is published, so a guide that implies December below about 45k would be news. The skew paying for downside says the market leans this way already.
findings.independence: Proxy: CPCA via https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/19/cpca-estimates-china-nov-nev-retail-1-15-million/ (industry, not company). HK shares fell 2.95% on 2026-11-13 on weak market data (https://wap.stockstar.com/detail/IG2026111300022010).

findings.finding: Q4 ramp evidence: the company said on 2026-10-30 it would lift i6 monthly capacity to 20,000 in November and higher in December. Deutsche Bank (2026-11-10) estimates over 50,000 cumulative i6 orders, 9-11 week waits and November deliveries above 40,000 including 16-20k i6. The i9 passed 10,000 cumulative deliveries on 2026-11-13 (5,460 in October) and the Mega exceeded 3,000 in October. That supports a Q4 guide of about 115k+ with y/y growth and a richer BEV mix.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print in 2026 has carried a Q4-style ramp guide. Every 2026 guide was below the street and sold.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock down 15% in two weeks to near its 52-week low, with downside skew, is not pricing DB's 40k+ November. If it were, the 20d run-up would not be negative after the i6 launch. Weekly company registration data for November could not be found, so the ramp is unconfirmed in public data before the print.
findings.independence: Deutsche Bank estimate: https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/10/li-auto-updated-i6-orders-estimated-above-50000/. i9 milestone: https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/13/li-auto-i9-tops-10000-deliveries/. Asia-Pacific and Europe launches: https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/10/li-auto-asia-pacific-expansion-5-markets-prepare-launch/.

findings.finding: Management has guided the next quarter below the street on consecutive prints: the Q3 2026 revenue guide was RMB26.6-28.0bn vs RMB32.28bn expected (about 15% below), the Q2 2026 guide RMB24.1-25.4bn vs 26.3bn, and the Q1 2026 guide included a vehicle margin of about 5%. The shares fell after each.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 print: -1.3% premarket on the guide. Q1 2026 print: nearly -5% premarket, HK -3.8%. Q4 2025 print: shares fell on weak Q1 guidance.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the street has cut its numbers since, revenue from about $4.80B to $4.09B. The habit of conservative guiding makes a below-street Q4 guide more likely than a coin flip, but the size is small because estimates have already come down.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 reaction: https://www.itiger.com/news/1138136218. Q4 2025 reaction (Bernstein 'brutal', 5% vehicle margin guide): https://uk.marketscreener.com/news/li-auto-shares-fall-after-sharply-lower-profit-weak-guidance-ce7e5fd2df88f72c. It overlaps with the Q4 volume finding only in sign, not in document.

findings.finding: Expectations are low going in: the ADS fell from $12.49 (2026-11-11 close) to $10.64 (2026-11-24), -8.0% over 5 days, and sits 2.4% above its 52-week low. Q3 revenue consensus has been cut from about $4.80B to $4.09B and sentiment is described as moving from deeply to modestly bearish. The bar the price holds is below where it was at the October deliveries.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not established for this name. The 2026 prints sold off from higher starting points; none started this close to the 52-week low.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself, so it is priced by definition. The finding is that the hurdle for a relief move is lower than the consensus-at-top-of-guide framing suggests. If the run-down had been neutral, the 5-day return would be near the sector's, which could not be checked.
findings.independence: Nov 11 close: https://www.foxbusiness.com/quote?stockTicker=LI. Spot and run-up: the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: The option market leans down: 25d skew +7.26 vol points (put over call) on the 2026-11-27 expiry, with an event-implied move of 5.95%. Open interest is only 3,166 and the ATM spread is 67% of mid.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the market's own statement. Filed so the judges see that the downside lean is paid for. The thin open interest makes it a weaker signal than on a liquid chain.

findings.finding: Short interest is about 29.9m ADS with 10.2 days to cover, up slightly from about 29.1-29.3m in Sep-Oct. Ten days to cover gives a cover-on-relief mechanism if the Q4 guide shows growth.
findings.why_not_priced: The share of float short is modest, so this is a small asymmetry, not a squeeze setup. A crowded short would show a sharply rising settlement, and this one is flat.
findings.independence: Earlier snapshots are search snippets only (FINRA 2026-09-15 about 29.26m, DTC 9.45).

findings.finding: Samsung's 29-inch OLED shortage hits Li Mega units built 2026-11-10 to 2026-12-17. They ship with the L9 Livis LCD instead, with free OLED replacement from 2027-03-01 and a 3-year service package as compensation. That is likely a Q4 warranty or compensation provision, but deliveries continue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 2025 Mega recall cost took 4.1pp off gross margin (16.3% reported vs 20.4% ex-recall) and the shares fell. This item is far smaller.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since Nov 2 but unquantified. It could appear as a margin caveat in the Q4 guide commentary. With no path to the guide it is sized as a fraction.

findings.finding: Peer Xpeng (2026-11-16) guided Q4 deliveries to 169-174k (+45-50% y/y, 7% above Goldman's expectation) and revenue to RMB30.4-31.8bn, and the shares rose 3%+ premarket. Its gross margin fell to 18.9%.
findings.link: Both are Chinese premium NEV makers with US ADRs and an overlapping BEV SUV segment (Li i6 at 239.8-249.8k yuan vs Xpeng's SUVs), in the same domestic market and the same quarter. Xpeng's Q4 strength is driven by the Mona L03 and exports (26% of Q3 volume), which Li lacks, so the read-through is weak.
findings.why_not_priced: LI has fallen since Xpeng's print, so the market did not carry Xpeng's strength over to LI, and rightly so given the different drivers. Sized small.

findings.finding: Cost headwinds for the margin outlook: management has said rising battery, memory-chip and circuit-board costs will be absorbed rather than passed on to buyers (as reported 2026-11-18, statement date not given). Xpeng named memory/AI-component inflation and a pending battery consumption tax as 2027 headwinds on 2026-11-16. A cautious Q4 or 2027 margin message is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 vehicle-margin guide of about 5% preceded a fall.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus still has the margin rising (DB 16.7%). A margin guide that stalls would surprise against that. The management statement is undated and secondhand, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Xpeng's 2027 headwinds: https://finviz.com/news/423292/xpengs-q3-beat-its-own-revenue-guidance-and-guided-q4-sharply-higher-but-margin-mix-and-2027-cost-headwinds-weigh-on-the-shares (a peer statement, linked by the same supply chain for memory and batteries).

findings.finding: Mach M100 chip: CEO Li Xiang said on 2026-11-17 that it will gradually be opened to outside robotics customers. On 2026-10-16 the chip unit raised RMB1.625bn (RMB1bn from Li Auto, RMB625m external) and stays consolidated. Possible AI-narrative colour on the call; no revenue yet.
findings.why_not_priced: No customers or timeline were named, so it is a narrative item only. The financing funds a consolidated unit with outside investors, so it is not a distress signal.

findings.finding: From 2027-01-01, extended-range and plug-in passenger NEVs lose the vehicle and vessel tax exemption while BEV passenger cars keep it. This may pull some EREV (L-series) demand into December and supports the Q4 guide a little.
findings.why_not_priced: Small annual tax, so a small pull-forward. This is macro-to-company transmission the company has not confirmed.

findings.finding: Capital: cash was RMB87.5bn at end-June. About $631.5m of the $1bn buyback had been used by Aug 26, leaving about $370m, and the stock is now about 47% below its 52-week high. A buyback extension or top-up is possible on the call.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced. Speculative, so sized small.

outside_window.finding: November deliveries (DB expects above 40,000, including 16-20k i6) are published around 2026-12-01, after the window. Only what the Q4 guide implies about them lands inside it.
Peer Nio reports Q3 and gives its Q4 guide on 2026-12-01.
Free Mega OLED screen replacements start 2027-03-01, with the cost falling in 2027.

2027 trade-in subsidy terms: not announced in any source found

baseline_tension: The evidence is balanced and does not cut against the downside skew. A low starting point (-8% in 5 days, near the 52-week low) and a likely margin step-up offset a weak October, weak industry November and a habit of guiding below the street, so p_up stays at 50 rather than leaning against the skew.
lessons_applied: Lessons 1 and 6 (inside the guide): Q3 revenue finding cut from +0.5 to +0.2, because deliveries at the top of the guide were published Oct 1 and revenue lands inside the guided range
Lesson 6 (bar single-sourced): margin finding capped from +1.0 to +0.7, because the RMB942m loss consensus and the 16.7% gross-margin view come from one source

Lesson 5 (proxy vs company number): Q4 volume-risk finding from -2.0 to -1.5, because part of it rests on CPCA industry data; i6-ramp finding from +1.5 to +1.2, because November volume rests on a DB estimate and is not a company figure
Lesson 2 (one-offs): Mega OLED provision from -0.3 to -0.2; Mach chip from +0.2 to +0.1 and the EREV tax from +0.2 to +0.1 (narrative and macro items with no stated path to the guide)
Lesson 7 (skew): p_up moved from 51 to 50, since a positive lean against +7.26 skew needs a reason the option market is wrong and none is documented

Untrustworthy-history lesson: rebuilt the base rate from confirmed releases (Q1 2026 about -5% premarket, Q2 2026 -1.3% premarket on below-street guides) instead of the baseline's monthly-update history; abs_move kept at 6.5 from the option anchor
Left standing: the expectations, reaction-history, positioning, peer, cost-headwind and capital findings
